name: Horokanai (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Horokanai town emblem in red: a ring with three spokes and a bar at the top, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Horokanai, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 July 1958.

features.role: Horokanai town emblem — a ring with three spokes and a bar at the top, forming a stylised character
